statement: There is an absolute constant C0 < ∞ such that, for every integer k ≥ 2, every finite metric space with at least k + 1 points, and every distinct initial labeled tuple u, there exists a randomized online policy A satisfying E  costA,u(w)  ≤ C0 log(k + 1) 2 OPTu(w) (3) for every fixed finite request word w chosen independently of its random choices. The same policy serves all words and all horizons. At each request it chooses one labeled server and moves that server to the request, leaving the others fixed.
